description: Reverse text by characters, words, lines, or reverse each line individually.

faqs.a: Characters flips the whole string ("abc" → "cba"). Words keeps each word intact but reverses their order. Lines reverses line order; "each line" reverses the characters inside every line.
faqs.q: What do the four modes do?

faqs.a: Yes — it uses Array.from, which splits text into full Unicode characters, so emoji and accented letters stay intact instead of breaking into halves.
No. Reversing happens entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Paste your text into the input box.
Choose a mode: characters, words, lines, or each line reversed.
